[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] '''Wilena''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a member of the [[Lamont Dynasty of Daimar]] and the grand-daughter of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mitar]], the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]]. She born to Mitar's daughter Princess [[Erra]] and her [[Wilena's father|father]] [[Death/Legends|died]] during one of the [[Trade Conflicts]] between Daimar and neighboring worlds shortly after Wilena's [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]], while her mother was killed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], when Wilena was 15 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, Daimar refused to submit to the new regime and the Empire [[Blockade of Daimar|blockaded]] the planet. Mitar realized that Daimar would eventually have to surrender, so he arranged for Wilena, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Alet Komain]] and a small group of individuals that he didn't want to be captured by the Empire to leave Daimar in the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Wasaka]]'' and make contact with Mitar's son Prince [[Torrin]], who led an off-world resistance group. The ''Wasaka'' made it past the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] and transported Wilena and the rest of the passengers to the planet [[Byrsym]], where they made contact with Torrin's organization. They then flew aboard the ''Wasaka'' to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], where they rendezvoused with Torrin and his group.<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />
